children.text: Customize your avataaar with features
Browse the components library for cool items and facial features to add to your avataaar!
•	TOP: The customization starts with the Top (hair and accesories). Other tops allow you to change or remove facial hair. Neat!
•	ACCESSORIES: Add or remove glasses from your avatar.
•	EYEBROWS: Select the type of expression you want your eyebrows to have. You can select a “natural” look or “outline” look, which is a bit more cartoonish.
•	EYES: The window to the soul! Select from different expressions. Inspired by emojis 😉
•	MOUTH: Select different type of smiles, frowns, or screams!
•	CLOTHES: Select different types of shirts, jerseys, and overalls!  Tip: Add some character to your tees by adding a Graphic.
Add some colour

To change the colour of  components, click on the "Layers" icon on the left and expand all of the component's folders. You are free to change the colour of any element within the folders, but I recommend changing the colour of elements that begin with the "🎨" emoji.

In the Assets, under "Palette", you'll find a curated list of colours. You can also find these colours in the colour picker in the right apanel, as well as by clicking on the "Colour Palette" icon on the left.
Wanna collaborate?
Illustrations themselves
The original library was created by Pablo Stanley and was created for Sketch (
https://avataaars.com

). If you wanna expand on this library, you can use it as a template, add your own stuff, and then publish it for everyone! If you want to make your additions part of the official libray, just shoot Pablo Stanley a PM on Twitter when you have something and he’ll update it!
https://twitter.com/pablostanley 👈
Penpot port

The conversion, reorganization of files, and revision of instructions for Penpot was done by myself, candide ✷ media. If you notice any bugs, or want to collab on porting another Sketch, Figma, Adobe XD, or Lunacy library for Penpot, reach out to me via:
- GitHub:
https://url.candide.media/github
- Contact form:
https://url.candide.media/contact-form
